description: Use this when the user wants a team member to have a different role (admin, editor or viewer) or to cover different monitors. Returns the member's old and new role; FlareWarden emails the member about the change. Owners and admins only: nobody changes their own role or the owner's, and only the owner changes an admin's. Not for inviting someone new (use invite_member) or removing a member (done in the dashboard).

member.description: The member's email address, or their user id from list_team.

role.description: The new role: admin (everything but billing), editor (manages monitors in their scope) or viewer (sees everything and gets alerts).

scope.description: Which monitors the role covers. Leave out to keep the member's current scope (all for a monitor-only member).

name: change_member_role
title: Change a member's role
